chunks: I said to Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام: Inform me about what Allah, Exalted is He, has made obligatory of the prayers.

He said: “Five prayers in the night and the day.” I said to him: Did Allah name them and clarify them in His Book? So he said: “Yes. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said to His Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله:
“Establish the salat from the decline of the sun until the darkness of the night.”

And its decline means its passing the zenith. So in what is between the sun’s decline and the darkness of the night are four prayers, which Allah named, clarified, and timed. And the darkness of the night is its midpoint. Then He said:
“And the recitation of dawn; surely the recitation of dawn is witnessed.”
So this is the fifth. And He said regarding that:
“Establish the salat at the two ends of the day.”
And its two ends are al-Maghrib and al-Ghadāt.
And it is the salat of al-ʿIshāʾ al-Ākhirah. And He said:
“Guard strictly the prayers, and the middle prayer.”

And it is the salat of al-Ẓuhr, and it is the first salat that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله performed. And it is between two daytime prayers: the salat of dawn and the salat of al-ʿAṣr.” And he said in some recitation:
“ ‘Guard strictly the prayers and the middle prayer’ and the salat of al-ʿAṣr, ‘and stand before Allah devoutly,’ concerning the middle prayer.”

And it was said: this verse was sent down on the day of al-Jumuʿah while the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was on a journey, so he performed qunūt in it and left it as it was in travel and residence, and added two rakʿahs for the resident. The two rakʿahs which the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله added on the day of al-Jumuʿah for the resident were only due to the place of the two sermons with the Imam. So whoever performs it on the day of al-Jumuʿah outside congregation, then let him perform it as four, like salat al-Ẓuhr on the rest of the days.

key_terms.الْوُسْطَىٰ: the middle prayer, identified here as Ẓuhr
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيْنِ: two units of prayer added for the resident in Jumuʿah
key_terms.غَسَقِ: the darkness or deepening of the night
key_terms.قُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ: the dawn recitation, referring to the Fajr prayer
key_terms.لِدُلُوكِ: at the sun’s decline from its zenith

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام explain the five daily prayers from the Qur'an?
ai.summary: This hadith explains that Allah has obligated five daily prayers and that their times and identities are indicated in the Qur'an. Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام interprets several verses to identify the daily salat times, clarifies that the middle prayer is Ẓuhr, and mentions a ruling concerning Jumuʿah prayer for one not praying in congregation.
